tool_descriptions.text: Mint an immutable value through the certifier (license: c7_pin_well_founded — references resolve only to already-admitted digests). The value's canonical bytes become its digest, its name forever. There is no update: revision is a successor declaration pinning its predecessor.

Digest to value, verify-on-read (license: content addressing — the decode re-derives the digest of what it fetched and refuses on mismatch). No anchor parameter exists: a digest names one value forever, so nothing an anchor could change. Head-relative reads are kernel_fold.

Attributed evidence onto a lane (license: f2_trace_invariant — duplication and reordering of deliveries cannot move the folded state). Not a send: no point-to-point primitive exists; lanes mean, subjects route.

Merge a contribution into a lattice cell (license: f1_cell_merge_aci and the join-semilattice package — associative, commutative, idempotent, so arrival order and duplication cannot matter). No ordering parameter and no conflict strategy exist; idempotent join leaves nothing to choose (refusal: last-writer-wins, machine-applicable repair).

Read reduced state at a checkpoint (license: f3_resume_exact for resumption; f11_query_deterministic — the answer is a function of support and query alone). Every head-relative read is this tool: search, views, rosters, audits. The anchor names the position the answer is true at; it is never wrong later, only earlier.

The fenced one-winner commit (license: at_most_one_landed_commit over monotone tokens — at most one outcome lands per register). The one priced act. At most one landed outcome is not at most one external side effect.

Deposit a standing monotone reaction (license: f10_stability — a predicate that holds at a state holds at every grown state; an enabled firing never un-fires). Five productions exist; absence, negation, and deadline are unspellable (refusal: absence-trigger).

Derive a narrower writ (license: f9_policy_meet_semilattice and f9_tree_attenuation — the child is the meet of parent and request, and every descendant stays under the root grant). An escalating request is clamped, not refused.

field_descriptions.text: The declaration kind the minted digest is branded with.
The value's canonical bytes. One canonical form exists; excess or non-canonical bytes refuse.
Digest of the policy value this declaration acts under. Every referent inside value must lie in this writ's pinned universe (refusal: off-writ-referent).
The declaration kind the digest is branded with; a kind/brand mismatch refuses (cross-sort-identifier).
The content address to resolve. Absence is retryable; a digest mismatch is structural.
Digest of the declared evidence lane the envelope lands on.
The evidence body, canonical bytes. The envelope's message id is its digest, so redelivery is harmless.
Digest of the declared cell resource whose ACI algebra governs the merge.
The contribution value, canonical bytes.
Digest of the declared reduction (kind: index) being read.
The lane whose partition the anchor coordinates name.
The partition within the lane. Positions mean nothing across partitions.
The checkpoint floor position, within this partition only.
The state label at the floor, as the anchor fact recorded it.
The journal head the anchor observed, within this partition only.
The question, as declared data. A view passes a constant; any seed lives inside this value (refusal: ambient-query-input).
The work declaration digest that keys the register. No anonymous decision exists.
The fencing token, meaningful at this register only. Committing without it, or across registers, refuses (unfenced-decide, cross-sort-identifier).
The outcome value; the door decodes it against the capability's declared output schema.

Which of the five monotone productions. Each uses its own slots below: evidence-appears uses lane_digest+pattern; cell-reaches uses cell_digest+threshold; hole-reaches uses hole+stage; outcome-landed uses register_digest; head-advanced-past uses lane_digest+shard+position.
The declaration a firing hints at. Its landed claim dedups at the register.
evidence-appears, head-advanced-past.
evidence-appears: the observation pattern to await.
cell-reaches.
cell-reaches: the lattice threshold to reach at least.
hole-reaches.
hole-reaches: the stage to reach at least.
outcome-landed.
head-advanced-past.
head-advanced-past: fire once the head passes this position (within this partition only).
The authority being attenuated.
The requested authority; the child is parent meet request.
The law this refusal defends, by its real name.
The legal next move, taught as data.

comments.text: The kernel language projected as MCP tool input schemas. EXPLORATORY, hand-derived from the Lean model in verify/kernel at this commit; the design mandates projections be GENERATED from the one grammar and walled served-equals-derived — this file is the reference sketch that generation owes. Shapes follow the survey leans: eight flat tools, no oneOf, compound self-descriptive field names (a field is named for the value it carries), digests as prefixed opaque strings with pattern, integers only (I-JSON safe range; no floats exist in the canonical grammar). Constraints beyond type/enum may not be sampler-enforced by every provider; the admission door enforces them all, and a violation returns the taught refusal (see refusal_result).
Model uses short identity labels (sha256:NN); the running system carries 64 lowercase hex chars. The pattern below is the model's.

Every tool returns either its admitted result or this refusal shape. Refusal parity: the door never refuses without the law it defends and the taught repair; applicability marks whether the repair is a mechanical rewrite of the refused call (machine-applicable) or needs information the call does not carry (advisory).
